scope: Full original Hilbert XVI: real algebraic curve and surface arrangements, and dynamical number/placement of polynomial limit cycles.

status_definitions.published_result: A result in a verified published source; this label does not assert a new independent reproof.
status_definitions.preprint_claim: A versioned primary preprint claim; no publication or independent acceptance is inferred.
status_definitions.source_report: A historical statement, institutional report, or work-in-progress status rather than a newly established theorem.

review_limits: Version and theorem premises are binding; an unversioned URL does not imply all later versions were audited.
The DRR ledger is not an exhaustive certified 2026 inventory.
Repository proofs are internally audited written arguments, not established literature or a novelty claim.

sources.does_not_establish: Completion of all cases, a sharp H(2), or an audited exhaustive 2026 remaining-case count.

sources.title: Finite cyclicity of some center graphics through a nilpotent point inside quadratic systems

Center-ideal factorization and foliation-compatible derivation-division

sources.title: Asymptotic expansion of the Dulac map and time for unfoldings of hyperbolic saddles: Coefficient properties

sources.does_not_establish: An unfolding-uniform theorem verified by this review; full proof text was not audited here.

sources.title: Dulac's Theorem Revisited

premises: The function classes and derivation-division operations under examination
sources.does_not_establish: An infinite-cycle polynomial counterexample, refutation of Ecalle's separate proof, or falsity of fixed-field finiteness.

Balance and stated class axioms

sources.title: Local Uniform Finite Cyclicity of the H_14^3 Semihyperbolic Hemicycle in Quadratic Systems
sources.review_basis: Primary Theorems 2-3, Proposition 1, stopped-return correspondence, sections 27-28 and reuse discussion; not a complete independent proof audit

Common-domain source estimates, identity control, and open local zero bounds at all faces
sources.does_not_establish: Independent acceptance by this dossier, a sharp bound, I_2^1/I_4^1, or completion of all quadratic cases.

sources.title: Neutral Entry-Exit Cycles with Quadratic Grazing: Uniform Return Reduction and Local Two-Parameter Bifurcations
sources.version: arXiv:2607.27464v4, 2026-08-10; earlier title emphasized sharp cyclicity
sources.review_basis: Primary theorem and explicit realization sections

Neutral balance, quadratic contact, regular connector and unfolding-rank hypotheses

sources.title: A note on a recent attempt to solve the second part of Hilbert's 16th Problem
sources.review_basis: Primary text
sources.scope: Refutes a proposed universal quadratic-in-degree formula using established n^2 log(n)-scale lower constructions.
premises: The lower-bound constructions cited and compared in the paper
sources.does_not_establish: An exact asymptotic for the Hilbert number or a general upper bound.

sources.title: Limits of combinatorial patchworking
sources.review_basis: Primary text reviewed in the algebraic research subtask; metadata independently checked
sources.scope: Constructs T-curves for nonempty schemes through degree seven; excludes combinatorial patchworking for selected realizable degree-eight maximal schemes; Table 1 records remaining algebraic uncertainties.
premises: Specified regular combinatorial patchworking class
Distinguishing algebraic, T-curve, and pseudoholomorphic realizability
sources.does_not_establish: Algebraic impossibility of all schemes excluded as T-curves, or a realization of the repository's target <4 disjoint union 1<2 disjoint union 1<14>>>.

sources.title: Hilbert's 16th problem for arrangements of curves on a surface
sources.review_basis: Primary text reviewed in the algebraic research subtask; primary abstract independently checked
sources.scope: Combinatorial encoding by intersection data, Dyck words and rooted trees; classification of three-line/cubic arrangements and partial three-line/quartic arrangements.
premises: Transverse curve arrangements relative to a fixed cellular arrangement
sources.does_not_establish: General plane-curve schemes or real algebraic surface classification. It does not absorb the G1 kill sequences sep = exp(-1/epsilon^2) or L = 1/n, and it is not a limit-cycle theorem.

sources.title: A note on Hilbert 16th problem
sources.review_basis: Primary theorem statements in the published note
sources.scope: If H(n) is finite then H(n+1) >= H(n)+1, and the maximum is realized by structurally stable fields with only hyperbolic cycles.
premises: The Hilbert number H(n) as a supremum over degree-n planar polynomial fields
sources.does_not_establish: Finiteness of H(2), a chart covering, a C2 remainder, or G1.

sources.title: Darboux-type center conditions for families of planar polynomial vector fields
sources.review_basis: Primary abstract and stated generic Bautin-size bounds
sources.scope: Generic (residual) upper bounds on the Bautin ideal generated by Lyapunov constants, for homogeneous and nonhomogeneous families of any degree.
premises: Generic parameter conditions in a residual set
Lyapunov-constant / Bautin-ideal framework for a monodromic singularity
sources.does_not_establish: A coalescing-passage theorem, G1, or local cyclicity of I_2^1 / I_4^1. Leave G2 closed.

open_gates.target: Uniform actual coalescing-root and central passage
open_gates.acceptance: Cover no-root, double-root and first-root limits with physical domains, variational remainders and endpoint matching.
open_gates.failure: Escaping sequence, vanishing required margin or unbounded normalized remainder; primitive evaluation is insufficient.

open_gates.acceptance: Exact center/Bautin identity equivalence and closed terminating operations on actual remainders.
open_gates.failure: Frozen coefficients or a closure counterexample.

open_gates.acceptance: Joint actual return/admission representation with bounded chain, domain, norm, coefficient and branch data.
open_gates.failure: Unbounded format or uncontrolled Stokes/degeneration data.

open_gates.failure: A missing itinerary/endpoint or compactness without local bounds.

open_gates.acceptance: Explicit complex-nonsingular polynomial plus complete topology, or a theorem excluding every realization.
open_gates.failure: Bounded search failure, one excluded barrier layout or a lower component count.
